_about: Fixes check_names.py --movies applies to movie folder and file names. 'words': misspelled word -> right spelling, anywhere in a name. 'movies': title as written (typos above already fixed; case, spaces and a leading 'The' don't matter) -> the title and release year Plex's movie database uses. Plex matches movies by title and release year, so a DVD or box-set year in a name can match the wrong movie or none.

movies.Lady and the Tramp II Scamp's Adventure: Lady and the Tramp II Scamp's Adventure (2001)
movies.Beauty and the Beast The Enchanted Chris: Beauty and the Beast The Enchanted Christmas (1997)
movies.Free Willy Escape from Pirates Cove: Free Willy Escape from Pirate's Cove (2010)
